identity.name: RuDolph-Hermes-7B
identity.summary: RuDolph-Hermes-7B is a conversational model created as an homage to the Dolphin and OpenHermes versions of Mistral 7B.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only merge recipe and base model names; no training/evaluation details for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Checkpoint is a merge of two open-weight models; card does not trace the provenance of their training data.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not document the training or tuning datasets of the merged base models.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: No training data is provided for the merged checkpoint, limiting explanations of its outputs.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Because the training data of the merged base models is not accessible, output content cannot be attributed to sources.

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,530,776 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a merge created with mergekit, using the SLERP merge method with a Sigmoid-inspired curve.
training_context.training_data: This checkpoint is a merge of two pre-trained language models: cognitivecomputations/dolphin-2.2.1-mistral-7b and teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B.
